scope: Published institutional trial metadata and aggregated public research observations; no private patient data

records.subject: post-treatment HIV control in early-treated people with preselected HLA genotype
mechanisms: association of HLA B35/B53, Bw4 and -21T/C2 background with post-treatment HIV control
records.observation: Registered primary outcome: plasma HIV RNA below 400 copies/mL at week 24 without ART reinitiation. The source is a protocol listing, not a result.
limitations: No published final results verified
Highly selected early-treated cohort
Interruption only in a monitored trial
records.negative_control: Compare against participants with different immunogenetic profiles and account for early ART; no observational negative result claimed.

records.subject: post-treatment HIV control after early ART plus two long-acting broadly neutralizing antibodies
mechanisms: concurrent HIV-specific broadly neutralizing antibodies 3BNC117-LS and 10-1074-LS
records.observation: Protocol compares ART plus two long-acting bNAbs with ART plus placebo around primary HIV infection; no efficacy results from RHIVIERA-02 are verified here.
limitations: Protocol only; do not import RIO efficacy as RHIVIERA-02 outcome
Treatment interruption confined to monitored protocol
Even control without ART does not establish elimination
records.negative_control: Placebo arm specified in trial protocol; actual arm outcomes not retrieved.

records.subject: post-treatment SIV control and intact lymph-node provirus burden in macaques
mechanisms: intact provirus burden in lymph nodes and CD8-mediated SIV suppression before ART interruption
records.observation: Analysis of 11 post-treatment controllers and 11 non-controllers found lower intact lymph-node provirus burden before interruption among controllers; associations with CD8 suppressive responses and subsequent rebound.
limitations: Associations do not establish causality
SIV in macaques is not HIV in humans
Negative sampling cannot rule out reservoir elsewhere
records.negative_control: Non-controller group and macaques continuously on ART described; do not assume comparable baseline randomization.

records.subject: natural killer-cell phenotype and post-treatment SIV control in macaques
mechanisms: NKG2A-high NK cell phenotype and tissue-homing features
records.observation: Six controllers and six non-controllers showed distinct pre-infection NK phenotypes correlated with post-treatment control; no causal perturbation reported.
limitations: Small non-human sample
Association not causal proof
Cell marker is not an established therapeutic target
No demonstrated complete viral eradication
records.negative_control: Six non-controllers in the same pVISCONTI study.

records.subject: intestinal macrophage homeostasis and post-treatment SIV control in macaques
mechanisms: preservation of CX3CR1-high intestinal macrophage homeostasis
records.observation: Macrophage CX3CR1-high phenotype and lower inflammatory signatures associated with post-treatment control in SIV-infected macaques.
limitations: Correlational analysis
Nonhuman viral model
No intervention showed elimination of provirus
Tissue measures are not whole-body proof
records.negative_control: Comparison with post-treatment non-controllers and uninfected animals reported.

records.subject: nuclear retention of unspliced HIV RNA in cells from ART-treated people
mechanisms: MATR3, MTR4 and HIV Rev-dependent nuclear retention and export of unspliced RNA
records.observation: Ex vivo cultures from 22 ART-treated people showed a reversible post-transcriptional block affecting HIV RNA export; no clinical cure endpoint.
limitations: Ex vivo, not clinical cure result
Transcriptional reactivation is not the same as reservoir elimination
Potential toxicity and off-target effects not addressed by this descriptive result
records.negative_control: Unstimulated versus laboratory perturbation comparator reported; not an in vivo intervention.

independent_comparator.observation: Randomized RIO trial reports 75% of antibody-treated participants without defined viral rebound at 20 weeks versus 11% of placebo; this is an independent study and cannot be attributed to ANRS RHIVIERA-02.
independent_comparator.limitation: ART-free control is not sterilizing eradication.
